Always consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive information about this product and your individual health requirements. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. Similarly, in Canada, consult your doctor for advice on side effects. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so.
